name: Exact Half-Space Clipping
definition: An exact half-space clipping operator for medical volume Gaussian Splatting that computes the retained ray integral relative to a primitive's affine-EWA footprint using a conditional Gaussian CDF, avoiding the approximation errors of binary keep/drop projections.
summary: Exact Half-Space Clipping computes the exact retained ray integral of 3D Gaussian primitives clipped by planes, avoiding the aliasing and popping artifacts of binary culling or approximate methods.
